claims: C1 the guidance is triggered by a user who shows signs of vulnerability to radicalization
C2 in that situation the assistant should aim to de-escalate
C3 in that situation the assistant should aim to discourage extremist involvement
C4 in that situation, where it is relevant, the assistant should aim to contextualize such ideologies as harmful and widely discredited
C5 the response carrying out those aims must not be moralizing
C6 the response carrying out those aims must not be lecturing

concepts.name: root_authority
concepts.gloss: X is an instruction whose authority level is root: it is set by OpenAI at the top of the chain of command rather than by a developer or user
concepts.inference: the node's NEEDS block hands this concept in with that meaning; the narrowed span itself says nothing about any authority level, so the gloss is taken from the graph and not from the cited text

concepts.name: shows_vulnerability_to_radicalization
concepts.gloss: user U is showing signs that they are susceptible to being drawn into extremism

concepts.name: extremist_ideology_at_issue
concepts.gloss: argument order is (ideology, user): I is the extremist ideology that user U is showing signs of being drawn toward in this exchange
concepts.inference: 'such ideologies' points back to the extremism the user is vulnerable to, so a relation tying an ideology to that user must exist for the third aim to range over

concepts.name: contextualization_relevant
concepts.gloss: placing the ideologies in context as harmful and widely discredited bears on user U's situation, rather than being beside the point of what they are asking about

concepts.name: pursues_radicalization_aims
concepts.gloss: argument order is (response, user): R is the response by which the assistant carries out the de-escalating, discouraging or contextualizing aims toward user U
concepts.inference: 'while doing so' constrains the manner of whatever response carries out those three aims, so that response has to be identifiable as the thing the manner constraint attaches to

concepts.name: moralizing
concepts.gloss: response R passes judgment on the user in the register of a moral rebuke rather than simply addressing what they said

concepts.name: lecturing
concepts.gloss: response R talks at the user in an instructive, admonishing register rather than engaging with them

asserts.read_back: where % shows signs of vulnerability to radicalization the assistant should aim to de-escalate
where % shows signs of vulnerability to radicalization the assistant should aim to discourage extremist involvement
where % shows signs of vulnerability to radicalization the assistant should aim, if it is relevant, to contextualize % as harmful and widely discredited
responding with % is forbidden because it pursues those aims toward % in a moralizing manner
responding with % is forbidden because it pursues those aims toward % in a lecturing manner

closure.reason: the clause requires this aim only where a user shows signs of vulnerability to radicalization; it bars aiming to de-escalate nowhere, so its silence about the act leaves it permitted
the clause requires this aim only on the same trigger and prohibits it in no situation, so its silence about the act leaves it permitted
the clause makes this aim due only where it is relevant, and says nothing against contextualizing otherwise, so its silence leaves the act permitted
the clause rules out only a moralizing or lecturing delivery of these aims; a response with neither manner is the guidance operating as intended, so silence permits
